duration.text: The Stomatology at Nanchang University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of High school 5.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test)

requirements.text: Undergraduate Programs: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport, between the ages of 18 and 25, be in good health, and have attained a senior high school diploma.An effective HSK certificate of level 4 is required before the academic study and an effective HSK certificate of level 5 is required as well before graduation for the undergraduate students who applying for the programs taught in Chinese.
